description: A bearded, weathered man in a dark smock, flour on his sleeves and hands, leans over a table and presses a dark spiced dough loaf on a carved wooden board with a geometric border. A stone hearth with a fire burns at left, a lit candle sits on the table, and round brown cakes rest on pale wafer sheets at lower right next to bowls of flour and a jar of honey. The setting is a rustic medieval kitchen with wooden paddles on the wall and stacked firewood at right. No text, frame or border is visible; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
